assertions.name: classical_kernel_derived_variable_coeff
assertions.source: q→1: S(n)=I(n) (telephone) exactly; a_D(n)=I(n)/n satisfies the exact variable-coefficient kernel a_D(n)=((n−1)/n)a_D(n−1)+((n−1)(n−2)/n)a_D(n−2) (Lean-proved from the telephone recurrence); c_3=[2]_q exact (D=0). So τ is an exact q-rational of derived anchors (not a fit); the fixed-τ depth-2 is the n≤4 shadow of this derived super-exp kernel.

description: DERIVES the exact classical (q=1) binding kernel (lever-1/z2bn). q→1: S(n)=Σ_{λ⊢n}f^λ=I(n) (RSK/Burnside=Identity I, telephone/A000085). a_D^(n)=I(n)/n then satisfies the EXACT variable-coefficient kernel a_D(n)=((n−1)/n)a_D(n−1)+((n−1)(n−2)/n)a_D(n−2) (from the proved telephone recurrence; Lean-proved sorry-free in BindingClassicalKernel.aDClassical_variable_coeff) — super-exponential, the fixed-τ depth-2 being its n≤4 shadow. So τ is NOT a fit (exact q-rational of derived anchors); the fixed-τ MODEL is n≤4-effective. q-deformation: S(n)=S(n−1)+[n−1]_q S(n−2)+D(n), c_3=[2]_q exact, Habiro tail D(n) growing (q→1⇒D→0). Closes the classical-kernel gap modulo Identity I (keystone P1–P5). Scope-(a), no wiring.
